interventions.title: MADARASA YA KODI ("Kodi Coins") — the Classroom Sovereign Wealth Ledger**
interventions.description: Children run a real, spendable public treasury for their own school — and learn that tax is a thing you *control*, not a thing that happens to you.
tags: **MEDIUM** — the app and grant are TRA's; the classroom time depends on voluntary head-teacher opt-in, which is the real constraint.

interventions.title: KARIBU TIN ("Welcome Wallet")**
interventions.description: Your TIN arrives as a gift that already contains something valuable — before TRA asks you for anything.
tags: **MEDIUM** — USSD TIN issuance is within TRA's digital mandate; the reward is TRA's budget; only bank-credential acceptance needs partners.

interventions.title: KODI YANGU, MTAA WANGU ("My Tax, My Street")**
interventions.description: See your own shillings become a real thing on your own street — with your name on the wall.
tags: **HIGH** — because visible reinvestment requires genuine inter-agency coordination with local government; TRA cannot build a streetlight alone.

interventions.title: NGAZI ("The Ladder") — Formalization as Levelling-Up**
interventions.description: You don't register a business — you unlock the next tier, and you never want to drop back down.
tags: **MEDIUM** — presumptive tiers and badges are within TRA's administrative authority; only the credit-signal tie needs bank MOUs.

interventions.title: HATI SALAMA ("Safe Deed") — Property Protection Through Declaration**
interventions.description: Declare your property and TRA gives you a shield for your ownership, not a bill.
tags: **HIGH** — the protective value depends on Lands data TRA does not own; the self-declaration timestamp is TRA's, the title-shield is not.

interventions.title: URITHI SALAMA ("Secure Inheritance") — Compliance as Retirement Collateral**
interventions.description: Your lifetime of tax records becomes the key that unlocks a protected pension and a clean inheritance for your children.
tags: **HIGH** — requires pension-fund co-design; TRA alone can build the score but cannot fund the top-up.

interventions.title: DARAJA LA KODI ("The Tax Bridge")**
interventions.description: Your mobile money line *is* your tax registration — one consent, and you're in, with visibility that costs TRA almost nothing.
tags: **MEDIUM-HIGH** — TIN issuance is TRA's, but the data-consent architecture needs BoT and MNO alignment; scope only what consent law currently permits.

interventions.title: WATU WA KODI ("The Taxpayers' Circle") — Compliance as Communal Honor**
interventions.description: In Tanzania you belong to groups that vouch for you — so let your compliance be something your community celebrates, not something you hide.
tags: **MEDIUM** — the charter and recognition are TRA's; the leverage depends on voluntary group buy-in, which requires patient convening.
